rv.q: It is the kind of theatrical gamble that only Jacobs-Jenkins would demand—and that only the right creative team could successfully meet.
Under the direction of Greta Mae Geiser, the ensemble creates an unforgettable experience of laughter, loss, and the universal search for the meaning of life.

Geiser's ensemble commits to the material, at times with earnestness, at other times with a bit of philosophical distance, but always with an eye toward communicating the show's simple profundities with wit and grace.

cn.t: Critics praise this inventive production of Jacobs-Jenkins' modern morality play, lauding its random casting lottery structure and thought-provoking exploration of death and companionship that proves both hilarious and timeless.
